  Special Meeting Agenda
  CITY COUNCIL

Tuesday, January 12, 2021  4:00 PM  Teleconference

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a Special Meeting of the City Council, to be called to
order via teleconference at 4:00 p.m. on Tuesday, January 12, 2021. The agenda for the Special Meeting with the
items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth below.

Posted by the office of the City Clerk on Thursday, January 7, 2021.

NOTE:  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  Pursuant to the Governor's Executive Order N-29-20 and current State and County Public Health Orders,
  City Council Members will be participating via teleconference.

  - Members of the public may listen to the meeting live by calling: (1-669-900-6833) from any phone,
  Meeting ID: 896 1841 8511 Meeting Password: 993500. (Please note you will not have the ability to
  speak using the call-in option from a phone line.)

  - Public correspondence may be emailed to the City Clerk at laurenp@rollinghillsestatesca.gov. Emails
  received before 3:00 p.m. prior to the start of the meeting will be forwarded to the City Council for their
  consideration and included as part of the record.

  - Members of the public may comment online using eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes &
  Videos” page of the City’s website (www.rhe.city/MeetingAgendas). Once the agenda is published, there
  will be an “eComment” button next to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to
  the City’s SpeakUp page. After you register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda.
  These comments can be seen by the public, will be considered by the Council and become part of the
  record.

  - Members of the public who wish to speak during this meeting may join the Zoom meeting by accessing the
  Zoom app from a computer (downloaded at Zoom.com) or tablet or phone (downloaded in the App Store),
  by entering the following credentials: Meeting ID: 896 1841 8511, Meeting Password: 993500. Members
  of the public who join the Zoom meeting will not have video, and may request to speak using the following
  process: After joining the Zoom meeting, if you wish to speak, please select the "raise hand" option at the
  lower portion of your screen. The City Clerk will send you a chat message to identify which item on the
  agenda you would like to speak on and will unmute your mic at the appropriate time.

  -Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's website under Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos at www.rhe.city.

minutes_text:
MINUTES
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  JANUARY 12, 2021

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

A Special meeting of the City Council of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order
by MAYOR ZUCKERMAN at 4:08 p.m. via teleconference, pursuant to the Governor’s
Executive Order N-29-20 and current State and County Public Health Orders.

2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

3.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan and Zuckerman

City Council Members Absent:  None

City Staff Present:  City Clerk Lauren Pettit

4.  NEW BUSINESS

A.  INTERVIEWS OF COMMISSIONERS WITH EXPIRING TERMS, AND APPLICANTS
  FOR EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE, ENVIRONMENTAL ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  AND TRAFFIC & SAFETY COMMITTEE VACANCIES

The City Council conducted the following interviews, via Zoom Video Teleconference, of
Planning Commissioners and Park & Activities Commissioners whose terms expired
December 31, 2020:

  4:10 – Valerie Ciarolla
  4:20 – Ryan McCormick
  4:30 – Jeff Romanelli
  4:40 – Lisa Pope
  4:50 – Bridget Carman
  5:00 – Rick Edler

The City Council conducted interviews for the following applicants, via Zoom Video
Teleconference, for the vacancy on the Traffic & Safety Committee:

  5:20 – Bill Varner
  5:30 – Arthur Wisot
  5:40 – Pam Schachter

The City Council conducted interviews for the following applicants, via Zoom Video
Teleconference, for the vacancy on the Equestrian Committee:

  5:50 - Terry Griggs
  6:00 – Susan Robinson

The City Council conducted interviews for following applicant, via Zoom Video
Teleconference, for the vacancy on the Environmental Advisory Committee:

  6:10 – Lisa O’Malley

The City Council then deliberated on the interviews conducted and came to a consensus to
the following consensus:

  -  REAPPOINT THE FOLLOWING PLANNING COMMISSIONERS FOR
  TWO-YEAR TERMS EXPIRING ON DECEMBER 31, 2022: BRIDGET
  CARMAN AND RICK EDLER;
  -  REAPPOINT THE FOLLOWING PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSIONERS
  FOR TWO-YEAR TERMS EXPIRING ON DECEMBER 31, 2022:

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES – SPECIAL MEETING  1
JANUARY 12, 2021
   VALERIE CIAROLLA, RYAN MCCORMICK, JEFF ROMANELLI AND LISA
  POPE;
  -  REAPPOINT ALL INTERESTED COMMITTEE MEMBERS FOR ONE
  YEAR TERMS EXPIRING DECEMBER 31, 2021;
  -  APPOINT THE FOLLOWING APPLICANTS TO THE TRAFFIC & SAFETY
  COMMITTEE FOR ONE YEAR TERMS EXPIRING DECEMBER 31, 2021:
  BILL VARNER AND PAM SCHACHTER
  -  APPOINT THE FOLLOWING APPLICANTS TO THE EQUESTRIAN
  COMMITTEE FOR ONE YEAR TERMS EXPIRING DECEMBER 31, 2021:
  TERRY GRIGGS AND SUSAN ROBINSON
  -  APPOINT THE FOLLOWING APPLICANTS TO THE ENVIRONMENTAL
  ADVISORY COMMITTEE FOR ONE YEAR TERMS EXPIRING
  DECEMBER 31, 2021: ARTHUR WISOT AND LISA O’MALLEY

14.  ADJOURNMENT

At 6:40 P.M. MAYOR ZUCKERMAN adjourned the City Council meeting to 7:00 pm the
same evening, for the purpose of a Regular meeting.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Lauren Pettit  Steve Zuckerman
City Clerk  Mayor
